what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Pakistan in Australia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2846 Pakistani asylum seekers in Australia, 4.4% of all asylum seekers from Pakistan.
Refugees from Pakistan, a separate group, live mostly in Afghanistan, the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in 1995 and 1996 and in every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 252 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Australia only.
